aggregation_topology: recursive aggregate cases may opt into binary_tree
notes: The aggregate guest verifies each recursive child proof and the online/target checkpoint chain.

child_proofs.proof_bytes: private native compressed, Groth16, or Plonk SP1 proof bytes
child_proofs.public_values_bytes: private SP1 public values hashed, verified, and decoded in guest
child_proofs.vkey_bytes: native SP1 only: serialized child verifying key used by the host to attach the child proof
child_proofs.vkey_digest_words: native SP1 only: vkey digest passed to verify_sp1_proof
child_proofs.vkey_hash: private proof vkey hash checked against aggregation public input

chunks.child_proof_hash: sha256 of recursive child proof bytes
chunks.child_vkey_hash: SP1 training-fragment vkey hash checked by the child verifier
chunks.chunk_id: sequential k=8 child chunk id checked by guest
chunks.input_checkpoint_hash: must match child public start checkpoint
chunks.output_checkpoint_hash: must match child public final checkpoint
chunks.step_end: must match child training-fragment public span
chunks.step_start: must match child training-fragment public global_step_start

public_inputs: aggregate boundaries, recursive child roots, and expected child vkey material
